resources.string:
v1.2
- Stable app signing added so future APK updates install over older v1.2+ builds
- Version code increased for Android update detection
- Generic music-start announcement, without reading link names
- Webpage station mode for charger autoplay
- 17-second failover with temporary skip for bad stations
- Random intro sounds and connecting loop audio
- Quiet hours from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM
- Hour/half-hour, network, and battery announcements
